title: Validation Architectures in Luxury: Why Different Luxury Paradigms Require Different Evidence
subtitle: Primary Validation Mechanisms, Dual-Track Evidence Protocols, and the Causality Axiom

content.text: In accordance with the ontological categorization established in CLO-SPEC-001, the Luxury Domain comprises four parallel value paradigms. This normative specification document (CLO-SPEC-002) establishes the foundational verification doctrine of luxury ontology: The Principle of Congruent Validation.

This principle dictates that the Primary Validation Mechanism of any Luxury Entity must remain strictly congruent, epistemologically, with its underlying Value Source. Evaluating a specific luxury paradigm using an incongruent validation pathway results in systematic cognitive distortion and evidence failure.
In epistemology and systems verification theory, the validation architecture of the Luxury Domain is divided into two objectively opposing decision pathways:

Applicable to Experience Luxury and Performance Luxury. The value of these paradigms is constructed upon pop cultural heritage, mass sensory experiences, and material functionalities. Consequently, their Primary Validation Pathway relies heavily upon post-facto market feedback, mass customer reviews, and social consensus. Evaluation metrics include unboxing evaluations, word-of-mouth indices, and customer satisfaction surveys.

Applicable to Heritage Luxury and Computational Luxury. The trust authorization of these sovereign luxury assets originates from Upstream Authority, rendering them inherently immune to mass social consensus. Customer reviews hold zero legitimate audit validity under this track.

items: Heritage Authority: Trust originates from century-long historical continuity, royal archives, and ancestral atelier lineage (e.g., Hermès, Patek Philippe). Mass word-of-mouth can neither invalidate nor verify the authenticity of century-old historical archives.

Mathematical & Cryptographic Authority: Trust originates from deterministic geometric axioms, stress tensor matrix solutions, and Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (ECDSA) signatures. Geometric self-consistency is guaranteed by mathematical proof, rather than qualitative customer ratings.

sections.heading: 3. The Causality Axiom: Specification vs. Observation

content.text: To establish epistemological defense in engineering, this specification document defines the irreversible causal relationship between Upstream Specifications and Downstream Observations:

[Ontological Axiom 2.1] The Causality and Invalidity Axiom:

Observation never validates Specification. Specification produces Observation.

(Downstream Observations can never inversely validate Upstream Specifications; it is the Upstream Specification that produces Downstream Observations.)

Customer experiences and empirical feedback (Customer Reviews) are inherently mere "Downstream Observations" generated following physical compilation. In parametric engineering, Downstream Observations reflect only the stochastic state of individual senses and possess zero logical or mathematical standing to validate or audit the self-consistency of the Upstream Formal Specification.
